verdict.rationale: Lithic documents an official MCP server at docs.lithic.com/docs/mcp that connects AI assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot. Once connected, an agent can search docs, inspect endpoint schemas, generate code and execute live API requests, and a probe confirms the MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup, auth and transport details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Once connected, your AI assistant can search Lithic documentation, inspect endpoint schemas, generate integration code, and execute live API requests, all from within your editor.
Bring Lithic into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and other AI editors — search docs and run live API calls in flow.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.lithic.com/docs/mcp
